t: You're at the Imperial War Museum London, a British national museum and the headquarters of Imperial War Museums, which has five other branches in England. It was founded in 1917 to record the civil and military war effort and sacrifice of the United Kingdom and its Empire during the First World War. Its remit has since grown to cover all conflicts involving British or Commonwealth forces since 1914. Alfred Mond, the first Baron Melchett, an industrialist, financier and politician, is named as its founder.
